newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 28.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 28. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The first day of the national election campaign reportedly went ahead quiet and smoothly.

Indonesian and Malaysian officials will hold a two-day meeting in Bandung on Monday ahead of jointly submitting their dispute over the Sipadan and Ligitan islands to the International Court of Justice (ICJ) in The Hague in the Netherlands.
Bank Indonesia has said it would be careful about anonymous letters it has received regarding collusion within local banks.
Ousted Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) leader Megawati Sukarnoputri told 200 party cadre at her home on Sunday that they should not join in the election in the name of the PDI and not be provoked.
